summary: The PR addresses the IndexError by correctly handling the case when refit is False and the penalty is not 'elasticnet'. However, there are some minor style and potential logic issues.

issues.description: The variable 'multi_class' is used without being defined in the scope. It should be 'self.multi_class' to maintain consistency with other parts of the method.
Appending None to self.l1_ratio_ when the penalty is not 'elasticnet' might lead to confusion. It could be better to handle this case differently or document why None is appended.
